---
title: "Getting Started"
---

## Installation

Clone the repository and install dependencies:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JDeleon2342/nba_api-project.git
cd nba_api-project
uv sync
```

## Using the API

Our project provides a Python API to access and analyze NBA shot data.

### Load Shot Data

```python
from src.data_collection import load_dataset

shots = load_dataset("data/shot_data_clean.csv")
print(shots.head())
```

### Load Team Metrics

```python
from src.data_collection import load_dataset

metrics = load_dataset("data/team_metrics_clean.csv")
print(metrics.head())
```

## Running the Analysis

Execute analysis functions from the `src.analysis` module:

```python
from src.analysis import three_point_rate_by_season, rank_teams_by_three_point_adoption
from src.data_collection import load_dataset

shots = load_dataset("data/shot_data_clean.csv")

# League-wide three-point trend
trend = three_point_rate_by_season(shots)
print(trend)

# Teams ranked by adoption
rankings = rank_teams_by_three_point_adoption(shots)
print(rankings.head(10))
```

## Viewing Visualizations

Use the Streamlit app to interactively explore the data:

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

Then open your browser to `http://localhost:8501`.
